overview_description.description:
Placement is a coaching platform that helps companies develop high-performance teams. Individuals require guidance from coaches and experts who understand the challenges they face and the goals they strive for in order to realize their full potential.

They created Placement to provide individuals with access to the professional development services that they wished to have when assisting in the scaling of fast-growing companies like Flexport and Guild Education.

Placement was started in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
